description: 한국도로교통공단_어린이보호구역내 어린이 교통사고 다발지역 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로교통공단. 어린이보호구역에서 발생한 12세 이하 어린이 교통사고에 대한 사고다발지역 정보 - 대상사고: 1년간 스쿨존 내에서 발생한 12세 이하 어린이 교통사고(어린이는 보행자, 자전거 승차자 또는 개인형이동수단(PM)승차자) - 다발지역 선정조건: 반경 300m 내 대상사고 2건이상 발생지점 또는 사망 교통사... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로교통공단. Its tags are 어린이보호구역, 스쿨존, 어린이, 교통사고, 다발지역. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
